verdict.rationale: The OpenHands repo documents creating automations and workflows that run on a recurring schedule or in response to webhook events. This is backed by Agent Canvas as a control center for automations and several first-party background automation templates: incident triage, PR-label review, CI failure fixes, security remediation and Slack monitoring. missing for 10: in-depth setup and configuration docs for scheduled automations, independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
Watch for a configurable label on pull requests, inspect full PR context, and post an AI review comment once per label event.
